$provenance.target: Local conformance HQ from the recorded source, with disposable PostgreSQL, fake Zerops
steps: Use Node 24.19.0 and follow conformance/README.md for PostgreSQL, Git, Go and object-store prerequisites; run vp install in conformance/.
From conformance/ set recordings_dir to a new empty temporary directory outside the checkout.

From conformance/ run TMPDIR=/private/tmp GOTOOLCHAIN=local HQ_RECORD_EXEMPLARS="$recordings_dir" env -u HQ_COMMAND vp test run rolling-restart.test.ts s10a-github-app.test.ts s8-stream.test.ts s19a-link.test.ts s21b-interactions.test.ts -t "Every HQ instance's organisation view holds|An installation GitHub does not answer|An app no person is recorded|Members see whether the GitHub App is connected|A delivered application's deletion|Another person cannot enter a personal Chief|A Discord account is linked only".
The selected cases use local fake services; the navigation case reads through a second HQ instance.
Compare the generated live-updates.scope-changed.json value with this recording. Remove the temporary directory; the harness stops its local processes and fixtures.
$provenance.command: cd conformance && TMPDIR=/private/tmp GOTOOLCHAIN=local HQ_RECORD_EXEMPLARS=<empty-output-dir> env -u HQ_COMMAND vp test run rolling-restart.test.ts s10a-github-app.test.ts s8-stream.test.ts s19a-link.test.ts s21b-interactions.test.ts -t "Every HQ instance's organisation view holds|An installation GitHub does not answer|An app no person is recorded|Members see whether the GitHub App is connected|A delivered application's deletion|Another person cannot enter a personal Chief|A Discord account is linked only"
